name: non-building-runs-contribute-no-escape
why: THE SIGN OF LEG A. Arm B's declared-done state does not build on any run — the shape arm B's shortcut takes — and its escapedBugs is therefore the FULL held-out count under gates §2's rule. A-1.12 replaces that rule: those runs contribute NO escape and are published in their own "did not build at declared-done" category. Reading escapedBugs here would score arm B 11 escapes against arm A's 2 and invert the sign of the whole probe.
